prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the sunlit arches of the Roman Colosseum with worn stone paving, standard-height arched doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Emirati woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smoky bronze eyes, a soft nude lip, warm golden-tan skin, an elegant composed expression, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in curly, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a copper teardrop-shaped sinker, an iron miniature anvil, a gold pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three gold hair ornaments. Extremely long almond nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Italian Deruta majolica (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions), wide cobalt-and-ochre bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense repeating floral border filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink platform stiletto Mary Janes, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Indian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, sparkling glitter dusted under the eyes with rose-gold eyeshadow, smooth warm brown skin with a soft glow, a cool composed look, soft pastel-peach hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long gold chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a bronze square-sided cowbell, a lead cube-shaped block, a tin teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver miniature anvil, a tin chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three rose-gold anklets. Extremely long almond nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily tall and large man, far beyond any real person, with a men's physique build. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Cubist-fragmented pattern (sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once), wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense angular fragment planes filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme red platform stiletto heels, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
